title: Aidream omits the published guest Chat v2 start route and returns 404 before canonical fallback
surface: Aidream AI agent and Mandate start routes
organization_context: Public guest route; no authenticated organization header or user session
preconditions: Published extension start contract selects POST /v2/ai/mandates/extend.browser_chat for the guest Chat turn.
Live Aidream server SHA efe1eb6efead949c0b5cb179dc762a8674770cff mounts the AI router at /ai but not the documented v2 start paths.
reproduction: Use published Store CRX 0.2.205 in a clean guest profile and send a page-grounded Chat turn.
The v2 start request returns HTTP 404; the client fallback retries canonical /ai and receives HTTP 200.
Repeat with same-conversation follow-up and after panel reload; each turn has the same 404-to-200 sequence, while the browser receives terminal answers.
expected: Both published start paths (`POST /v2/ai/agent/{agent_id}` and `POST /v2/ai/mandates/{mandate_key}`) resolve to the same handlers and guest gate as their canonical `/ai` counterparts. Other operations remain on the unversioned routes named by the extension wire contract.
actual: Live server has no v2 start mount; each guest turn first receives a 404, adding an unnecessary request and relying on the client fallback. The fallback did return a successful answer in run 39046184558.
reproducibility: All three turns in resource-valid run 39046184558 observed 404 then 200, preserving conversation fingerprint and is_new per pair. Aidream route test was red with the v2 mount absent and passes with the narrowed shared start router. Post-deploy API-only retest observed 10/10 v2 Mandate requests reaching auth instead of 404.
severity: S2: extra failed request on every guest start; published client fallback succeeds
priority: P1: restore documented route for current published clients
cause: Aidream deleted its hidden `/v2/ai` start alias while published extension clients continued to use versioned agent and Mandate start paths. The canonical `/ai` route remains available for client fallback.
sibling_census: Separate extension observer fault EXT-D-0226 incorrectly required one POST and failed to record route class. Aidream now shares only agent and Mandate start handlers under `/ai` and `/v2/ai`; route tests verify tool results, resume, inbox, warm, and cancel remain unversioned.
acceptance_criteria: Only documented v2 agent and Mandate start routes are mounted with identical endpoint behavior and guest gate.
Other AI operations remain at the unversioned paths in the extension wire contract.
Route regression test fails before alias restoration and passes after; focused Aidream suite is green.

Fresh guarded published Store browser run verifies direct versioned 200 for opening, same-conversation follow-up and new conversation after reload; original 39046184558 remains failed and zero-credit.
